comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: If you have R7 Casting and the Special Mineral Smelting Book book, you can easily collect Yellow Ore in nearby Southeast Cairo to turn into sulphur so you don't have to sail all the way to Stockholm to buy them. :)

comments.author: ChingShi
comments.body: Do I need to finish quest "Learning from Paracelsus" in order to get this quest popped up?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Yes. This quest is unlocked by doing that quest first (hence the #1/#2 order in the quest chain). Which unfortunately means you need to do the chain leading up to "Learning" as well. Cheers, and good luck with alchemy.
